arguments.name: cmd
arguments.value:
set -eu
root=experiments/rpcg-micro-12/ci-red-green-acquisition-v1
out=$root/pre-attested-source-v2
mkdir -p "$out"
base=$root/scored-freeze-v1/EXCLUSIONS.json
inspected=$root/scored-acquisition-v2/public/INSPECTED_REPOSITORY_COMMITMENTS.jsonl
base_sha=$(sha256sum "$base"|cut -d' ' -f1)
inspected_sha=$(sha256sum "$inspected"|cut -d' ' -f1)
jq -n --slurpfile base "$base" --slurpfile inspected "$inspected" \
  --arg base_sha "$base_sha" --arg inspected_sha "$inspected_sha" '{
    schema:"rpcg.micro12b.pre-attested-source-exclusions.v2",
    v1_exclusions_sha256:$base_sha,
    v1_inspected_repository_commitments_sha256:$inspected_sha,
    repository_ids:(($base[0].repository_ids + ($inspected|map(.repository_id)))|sort|unique),
    repository_identity_sha256s:(($base[0].repository_identity_sha256s + ($inspected|map(.repository_identity_sha256)))|sort|unique),
    git_oids:($base[0].git_oids|sort|unique),
    excludes_all_v1_inspected_repositories:true,
    opens_v1_sealed_future:false,
    manifest_sha256:""
  }' >"$out/EXCLUSIONS.tmp.json"
manifest=$(jq -cS 'del(.manifest_sha256)' "$out/EXCLUSIONS.tmp.json" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
jq --arg manifest "$manifest" '.manifest_sha256=$manifest' "$out/EXCLUSIONS.tmp.json" >"$out/EXCLUSIONS.json"
rm "$out/EXCLUSIONS.tmp.json"
jq '{schema,repository_ids:(.repository_ids|length),repository_identity_sha256s:(.repository_identity_sha256s|length),git_oids:(.git_oids|length),excludes_all_v1_inspected_repositories,opens_v1_sealed_future,manifest_sha256}' "$out/EXCLUSIONS.json"
